title: Explore CAL
description: College of Arts and Letters advising, departments, fields of study, and high-impact practices. Connect with administrators, advisers, faculty, students, and other members of the college community.

title: CAL and Career Exploration
description: Exploration of course work and career pathways for humanities, social science, and physical science majors in the College of Arts and Letters. Course materials designed for lower-division students to acquire a breadth of knowledge of college resources and career options.

title: Mathematics and Quantitative Reasoning CAL Support
description: Required support course for General Education Mathematics/Quantitative Reasoning classes offered in the College of Arts and Letters (CAL).
notes: Credit in this course satisfies the SDSU Mathematics/Quantitative Reasoning Assessment requirement.

title: Internship for CAL Majors
description: Supervised internship with businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies. Introduces professional skills, reflection, and workplace learning. Students connect academic knowledge to applied contexts and develop foundational career readiness competencies.

title: CAL Experience
description: A multidisciplinary view of one topic within the larger College of Arts and Letters, as a way for students to understand the social sciences and humanities from multiple perspectives while studying the human condition. Topics will vary.

title: Career Readiness for CAL Majors
description: Development of career readiness skills for humanities and social science majors in the College of Arts and Letters. Course materials designed for upper-division students to acquire full-time positions upon graduation and full-time professional internships.

title: Study Abroad
description: Study abroad in Arts and Letters.

title: Advanced Professional Internship for CAL Majors
description: Advanced internship integrating academic study with professional practice. Students create a learning agreement, engage in reflection, and complete an integrative project demonstrating workplace analysis, career competencies, and professional skills growth.
